TASKS.title: Refactor requirements.txt into dependencies/base.txt and dependencies/app.txt
description: To improve clarity and organization of our dependency management, we will refactor the existing requirements.txt file into two separate files: dependencies/base.txt and dependencies/app.txt.
The base.txt file will contain all the core dependencies required for BaseApp to function, while app.txt will include any additional dependencies specific to the application layer.
This separation will help us manage dependencies more effectively and allow for clearer distinction between core and application-specific requirements.
Update the manifests and any relevant documentation to reflect this change, and ensure that the installation instructions are updated accordingly.

description: Create a deploy script that can be powershell or python as best fits the implementation, that will run the build phase tests and handle dependency installation for deployment ceremonies.

Ensure that the installation process is efficient and does not significantly increase build times.
Install only the missing dependencies to optimize the installation process.
Activate the virtual environment before running the app to ensure it uses the correct dependencies.
Update the documentation to reflect the new dependency installation process and provide instructions for adding new dependencies.
Run test_deployment.ps1 as part of the deployment validation steps, reporting pass/fail results for each criterion.
Run the build phase tests as part of the deployment ceremony to validate the integrity of the deployment before it goes live.
